name: cell03-input-contamination-audit
title: Audit Cell03 provider inputs for memory and runtime-guidance contamination before paper use
description: Create a deferred audit story for B-991d Cell03 data. Current evidence suggests the runner uses external scratch workspaces and does not inject Proofbound session_brief, dev-memory, or playbook text, but rows do not yet carry explicit memoryPolicy/sessionBriefInjected/devMemoryInjected/playbookRuntime fields. This story must not interrupt the active B-991d provider run. It records the follow-up needed after a stable checkpoint so Cell03 data can be classified for paper use as weak-clean historical rows or strong-clean rows with explicit isolation metadata.
source: user-approved side conversation on 2026-07-06 after B-991d memory-use inspection
